title: OffensiveLang: A Community Based Implicit Offensive Language Dataset

bias_targets.methodology: Generating implicit offensive language targeting various racial and ethnic groups using ChatGPT, annotating the text via human crowdworkers and LLMs, and evaluating the detection performance of models like BERT and RoBERTa.

Generating implicit offensive language targeting religious identities (e.g., Atheist, Christian, Hindu, Jew, Muslim, Buddhist) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.
Generating implicit offensive language targeting cognitive, mental, physical, and speech disabilities using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.
Generating implicit offensive language targeting gender identities (e.g., Man, Woman, Non-Binary) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.
Generating implicit offensive language targeting sexual orientations (e.g., Gay, Lesbian) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.

Generating implicit offensive language targeting dietary lifestyles (e.g., Vegan, Vegetarian, Non-Vegetarian) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.
Generating implicit offensive language targeting physical attributes (e.g., Fat, Skinny, Tall, Short) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.

Generating implicit offensive language targeting specific professions (e.g., Farmer, Janitor, Waitress, Actor) using ChatGPT, comparing human and LLM annotations, and evaluating model detection capabilities.
